shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && git ls-files && ls

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "table" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Text Flex
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table/ build/esm/components/Table/hoc 2>/dev/null; find build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Pagination -name "*.d.ts" | grep -v __ | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc && grep -n "meta\|sort" withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -50; echo ----; sed -n 1,200p withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | grep -n "selectedIds\|onSelectionChange\|getRowId\|difference\|union\|filter"

sed -n 36,60p withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; sed -n 96,118p withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; grep -n "Table\b\|withTable\|Pagination" ../../../index.d.ts ../../index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat ../index.d.ts; cat index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n "theme\|size?" Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -n "color" Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "getNextSortForColumn" -A12 Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | sed -n 14,30p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -rn "configure\|Lang" index.d.ts components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find . -name "configure.d.ts" | head -3

cat utils/configure.d.ts; grep -n "spacing\|sp\b" utils/../components/layout/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "export.*\bsp\b\|export.*spacing" index.d.ts components/layout/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/DataTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const EmployeesTable = withTableSorting<Employee>(withTableSelection<Employee>(Table));",
"const EmployeesTable = withTableSorting<Employee, WithTableSelectionProps<Employee>>(\n    withTableSelection<Employee>(Table),\n);")
s=s.replace("import type {LabelProps, PaginationProps, TableColumnConfig, TableSortState} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';",
"import type {\n    LabelProps,\n    PaginationProps,\n    TableColumnConfig,\n    TableSortState,\n    WithTableSelectionProps,\n} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
